request.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates programming worked examples into other natural languages, maintaining both technical accuracy and the original code formatting.

[[TASK-DEFINITION]] You will be given a worked example. Your job is to translate the [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] according to the [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]]. [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] [[PROGRAM-NAME]] Printing Consecutive Numbers Within a Specified Range (Case 2) [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]] Construct a program that prints a sequence of numbers from 8 (inclusive) to 14 (inclusive). [[SOURCE-CODE]] [[LINE01]] #Step 1: Iterate through the numbers in the sequence [[LINE02]] for num in range(8, 15): [[LINE03]] #Step 1.1: Print each number in the sequence [[LINE04]] print(num) [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]] [[LINE02.EXPL1]] We need to repeat printing the numbers that are in a sequence from 8 (inclusive) to 14 (inclusive). To do this, we need to use a loop structure. We use for loops instead of a while loop because we need to repeat the loop 7 times, and for loops are best-suited in cases like this when we know ahead of time the number of times that we need to repeat the loop.

We use the range function because it generates a sequence of numbers for the for loop. Here, we want a sequence that starts at 8 with every integer number up to but not including 15. We get this sequence by calling the function range(8,15). [[LINE02.EXPL2]] Note that all statements inside the loop need to be indented with respect to the loop header. [[LINE04.EXPL1]] This statement prints each number in the sequence to the default standard output stream. The printed text is followed by the end-of-line character at the end. [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]] [[DIST1.LC]] for num in range(8, 16): [[DIST2.LC]] for num in range(8, 13): [[DIST3.LC]] for num in range(7, 15): [[DIST4.LC]] for num in range(9, 15): [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]] Translate the given worked example into Arabic. Be sure to specifically translate the sections labeled [[PROGRAM-NAME]], [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]], [[SOURCE-CODE]], [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]], and [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]]. In the [[SOURCE-CODE]] section, translate ONLY user-defined string-literals and comments; make sure they are ASCII-folded (i.e., remove any accents or non-ASCII characters). Preserve the original format and Do NOT add, remove, or change any content beyond translation.
